2609.02679.title: From Tokens to Semantics: Leveraging Complementary Signals for Hallucination Detection in Black-Box LLMs
2609.02679.paper_summary: When LLMs support public-facing or high-stakes workflows, missed fabrications can harm users and institutions, while false alarms consume limited human-review capacity. When no trusted context or reference document is available, we study two signals accessible through black-box model APIs: semantic entropy, which measures disagreement among sampled response meanings, and uncertainty derived from token log-probabilities. Their failure modes can be complementary: semantic entropy becomes uninformative when responses form one semantic cluster, while token uncertainty can miss consistently confident errors. We extend token-based uncertainty detection by aggregating token-level signals across sampled responses through our TopK method, evaluate the hybrid CoCoA method, which combines target-response uncertainty with semantic dissimilarity, and propose and study two supervised methods: Gated, which routes single-cluster cases to an aggregated-token-feature classifier, and Stacked, which learns jointly from semantic uncertainty and broader token features. We evaluate seven benchmarks, including five public benchmarks (four text datasets and multimodal handwritten-cheque extraction) and two constructed benchmarks (Financial Summaries and Long-Text QA), using four language models. In our evaluation across models and datasets, Stacked gave the best performance in nearly half of the cases, while TopK and CoCoA remain competitive without supervised training labels, although their thresholds require careful calibration. No method is universally strongest. We therefore evaluate performance at false-positive-rate budgets from 1% to 15%, assess their sensitivity to generation and calibration choices, and examine variation across dataset characteristics.
2609.02679.paper_summary_zh: 當大型語言模型（LLMs）支持面向公眾或高風險的工作流程時，錯過的虛構內容可能會對用戶和機構造成傷害，而虛假警報則會消耗有限的人類審查能力。當沒有可信的背景或參考文件可用時，我們研究了通過黑箱模型API可獲得的兩種信號：語義熵，它測量抽樣回應意義之間的不一致性，以及源自標記對數概率的不確定性。它們的失效模式可能是互補的：當回應形成一個語義集群時，語義熵變得沒有信息，而標記不確定性則可能錯過持續自信的錯誤。我們通過我們的TopK方法擴展了基於標記的不確定性檢測，通過聚合抽樣回應中的標記級信號，評估混合的CoCoA方法，該方法將目標回應不確定性與語義差異性結合，並提出並研究兩種監督方法：Gated，將單一集群案例路由到聚合標記特徵分類器，以及Stacked，從語義不確定性和更廣泛的標記特徵中共同學習。我們使用四種語言模型評估七個基準，包括五個公共基準（四個文本數據集和多模態手寫支票提取）和兩個構建的基準（財務摘要和長文本問答）。在我們對模型和數據集的評估中，Stacked在近一半的情況下表現最佳，而TopK和CoCoA在沒有監督訓練標籤的情況下仍然具有競爭力，儘管它們的閾值需要仔細校準。沒有任何方法是普遍最強的。因此，我們在1%到15%的假陽性率預算下評估性能，評估它們對生成和校準選擇的敏感性，並檢查數據集特徵之間的變化。
